author.name: Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution

headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Getting a Floor Plan for Your Luxury Property

publisher.name: Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution

articleBody: Getting a floor plan for your luxury listing might seem straightforward, but there are some common pitfalls that can actually hurt your marketing efforts. One big mistake is treating a marketing floor plan as a formal survey. They serve different purposes, and misrepresenting one as the other can lead to issues. Another frequent error is using automated scans without double-checking the accuracy, especially for complex or multi-level properties. Some Matterport-derived plans, for example, can have a wider margin of error than professional, hand-drafted ones. You definitely want to avoid omitting crucial details like wall thicknesses, staircases, or detached structures, which can create confusion for potential buyers. And publishing incorrect square footage is a definite no-go – it's one of the quickest ways to erode trust. Finally, failing to disclose the measurement standard used can leave buyers questioning the data. For high-value properties, square footage is commercially sensitive, so precision and transparency are key. When professional help becomes important, it's for properties that are large, architecturally complex, multi-level, or where square footage is extremely important.
